subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to improve the bold part of the sentence.

He is one of those players who** has scored **the most goals.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the sentence, "He is one of those players who has scored the most goals," the pronoun "**who**" refers to "**players**," which is plural.
 
• When referring to plural antecedents, the correct verb form is "**have scored**" rather than "**has scored**."
 
• Thus, "**have scored**" is the grammatically correct option, ensuring subject-verb agreement.
 
• Options like "**had been scoring**" or "**had scored**" imply past perfect tense, which does not fit the context here.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"He is one of those players who **have scored** the most goals."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2:** "**had been scoring**" – This option implies continuous action in the past, which is not appropriate in this sentence.
 
• **Option 3:** "**Scores**" – This option uses present tense, which does not fit the context of the sentence referring to past achievements.
 
• **Option 4:** "**had scored**" – This option uses past perfect tense, which implies a completed action before another past event, but the sentence does not require this tense.
